'''Green Squadron 1''' was an [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|RZ-1 A-wing interceptor]] in service to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The fighter was part of [[Green Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Green Squadron]] during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]],<ref name="CCG-Green1" /> piloted by [[Green Leader/Legends|Green Leader]]<ref name="CCG-GreenLeader">{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=Green Leader}}</ref> [[Arvel Crynyd/Legends|Arvel Crynyd]].<ref name="TechJournal" /> The fighter was constructed at the zero-[[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] [[Chardaan Shipyards]] and was deployed as an escort for [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wing]] and [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]] attack missions.<ref name="CCG-Green1" />

During the Battle of Endor, Green Squadron 1 assaulted the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] ''[[Executor/Legends|Executor]]'' after it had lost its [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]]. Hit by weapons fire, Crynyd's out-of-control fighter slammed through the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought's]] bridge, resulting in a complete loss of command and control. The ''Executor'' subsequently crashed into the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]].<ref name="ROTJ" />
